description: Take the New mark off generated tests, as opening one in Test Lab does. A test is new from when a generation saves it until someone opens, edits or marks it seen; Test Lab lists them under New tests. Name the tests, or pass all=true for every new test of the project. Returns the ids it marked.

all.description: Mark every new test of the project seen.
all.title: All

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

tests.description: The saved test ids to mark seen. Leave out with all=true.
tests.title: Tests

name: mark_tests_seen
